en.label: Prerequisites:
en.content: Food Hygiene or Food Conservation or Food Microbiology I.

The concept of the food quality is specified in the introduction to the course. The students are made acquianted with the general model of the quality assurance according to the ISO 9000 standards and consequently with the application of these standards in the food industry according to the Quality Management System. The hub of the course is the acquiring the knowledge concerning the current Czech food legislation in the context of the European food legislation. Students acquire the view on the philosophy of the Czech Food Law, including the following procedural regulations within the competence of the Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Agriculture. The state supervision on the compliance with the food legislative standards is specified in the final part of the course. (allowance 0/0)
